purpose: Produce one corrected API call snippet for one located API/namespace mismatch in a target-version signature.
trigger: Use when one failing call is identified and the target version signature is available.

inputs.name: failed_call
inputs.description: One failing call expression, source location, error, and unchanged surrounding context.

inputs.name: target_version_signature
inputs.description: Target API owner, namespace/member, argument names/types, and authoritative reference.

preconditions: Error is localized to one call/namespace and target signature is authoritative.
Modeling strategy and parameters are not being changed.

outputs.name: corrected_call_snippet
outputs.description: One copyable replacement call, not a workflow.

outputs.name: needs_manual_review
outputs.description: True when target signature or one-call boundary is unproven.

postconditions: Corrected snippet matches target signature and changes only the located binding.
Unknown/conflicting signature returns needs_manual_review with no invented call.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. Output is a call snippet for caller testing; it is not runtime/API proof.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Target API signature cannot be established.
failure_modes.detection: Reference is missing/conflicting or inferred from another version.

failure_modes.condition: Patch changes more than one binding.
failure_modes.detection: Diff includes unrelated parameters/strategy or multiple calls.

recovery.action: Return needs_manual_review and request exact signature.
Reduce to one binding or return needs_manual_review.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Corrected snippet matches target signature and changes only the located binding.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
